# A brick (1, at 160,128) and a block of dark rock (3, at 208,128) stand at the player's height, each over a pit
# down to the floor, so their rubble falls in the open. The player (@) picks up the Mattock (255) and swings at the
# brick (287): it breaks (297), and its destroy event's x+8+rand(0,8)-rand(0,8) puts its three pieces of rubble at
# x 162-176 and y 133-139, over the brick's own place. He jumps the pit onto the block between the two pits, before
# the dark rock (316) and swings at it (346): it breaks (356), and oDark's x+8+rand(0,8)-rand(0-8), whose rand(0-8)
# is -8..0, puts its rubble at x 221-231 and y 144-147, 13 to 23 px right of the block's corner and 16 to 19 below
# it, so it falls past the block's right edge. Neither block has gold in it.
